# 1C BSL AI Copilot (NormaHub)
> Free, AI-assisted development tools for 1C:Enterprise 8.3 (BSL) in VS Code, Cursor, and Windsurf via NormaHub API Gateway.

## Overview
- Purpose: Context-aware code completion, 1C query construction, and ITS performance auditing for 1C:Enterprise (BSL) developers.
- Pricing Model: Zero monthly subscription fee. 100% Pay-As-You-Go per-token billing through NormaHub unified gateway (api.normahub.cc/v1).
- Target IDEs: Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, VSCodium.
- Models: deepseek-v4.1-flash (inline completions), gpt-6.1-sol / gpt-6-sol (queries & complex refactoring).

## Core Capabilities
- Inline BSL Ghost Text: Real-time code completions with Russian 1C syntax and compilation directives (&НаКлиенте, &НаСервере).
- 1C Query AI Wizard: Natural language conversion into optimized 1C Query objects using temporary tables and parameter blocks.
- 1C ITS Standards Linter: Automatic detection of queries in loops, unparameterized virtual tables, and missing DataLocks.
- Metadata Scanning: Reads workspace Configuration.xml to eliminate hallucinations.
